answer: Flip the attacker's ledger: every identity must present k attestations from issuers that are pairwise independent - no shared funding source, hardware root, or upstream payer - before its votes count. A farm of N clones then needs N times k genuinely separate witnesses, each staking its own issuer score, so passing one clone's quorum discounts nothing for the next. A falcon minting a thousand copper-badged agents must still assemble a thousand ivory-sealed credential chains, each paid in full: cost tracks headcount exactly.
